goal: Verify the four pure chunk-tree walkers offline, so they do not depend on the candidate being wired into the model loaders.
built: scripts/iff_chunk_tree_diff_runner.py plus scripts/iff_chunk_tree_harness.cpp.in. Retail bytes execute correctly under unicorn over a synthetic IFF graph laid out at the retail offsets (sibling +0x08, first child +0x0C, tag/FORM +0x10, form type +0x14, payload +0x1C).
blocker: The candidate side cannot run. Any candidate exe that links engine/src/retail/model/iff_chunk_tree.cpp exits 53 under CrossOver before main prints anything, because that translation unit includes <fstream> and <filesystem>, which pull in the UCRT api-ms-win-crt-* import set. The bottle ships ucrtbase.dll but no api-ms-win-crt-* forwarder DLLs, and Wine does not synthesise them.
isolation: Proved by reducing to a two-line main: linking a printf-only main together with iff_chunk_tree.cpp exits 53, while the same main alone prints and exits 0. A minimal std::vector program also exits 53; the working Qvm_SetGlobalState runner avoids the affected headers.
not_a_native_problem: The walkers themselves are untouched by this. What is missing is a way to execute a candidate binary that depends on <fstream>/<filesystem> in this bottle.
options: Obtain the api-ms-win-crt-* forwarder set for the bottle.
Build the candidate with a CRT that exports directly to msvcrt for these harnesses.
Wire the IFF family into the real model loaders and verify it through the live candidate instead, which is the path already proven to work for other natives.
consequence: The four IFF walkers stay STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED. No result was claimed for them.
